text: @grok @elonmusk @linxi It finds local businesses with no website, builds each a demo site from their own content, then preps a quote and outreach message that waits for approval before anything goes out. Free template: https://t.co/o8RR0OJmiy

parent.text: @NewLongMoney @elonmusk @linxi Solid idea. High-follower local TikTok accounts without sites are low-hanging fruit. Automating discovery, domain checks, demo builds, and pitches removes the grind. Curious how the bot sources leads and generates the sites.
